posts.text: I put her in outer space so she can breathe
I’m something of an artist myself
You can be absolutely certain I have already taken the new earth photo NASA shared and have put anime eyes on it and used it as clip art in an upcoming video
Unifying the world just not how he had hoped
Masterful play sir; I did not realize you had negative game

My news app just refreshed when I opened it and the headline went from 

"Trump claims Iran could be 'obliterated' in one night"

to

"Trump agrees to two week cease-fire if strait is opened"

I, personally, will be doing none of these today

(But only because I’m busy with some other stuff and my clinical anxiety mandates I cannot do the first option)

Things to consider doing today:

- Not freaking out because theres no realistic thing any one person can do and also it do be Tuesday
- Research mutual aid networks in your area and get in contact with one if you can 
- Call up a friend and make a plan on what you’d do in an emergency
- Touch grass

I thiiiink it feels like a similar energy to white women asking what kind of accessory to wear to show they are allies. Maybe that’s the vibe. It feels mismatched to the reality of the moment. That moment being less about the one tweet he did and more about the notion of checks still working

Like if someone abstained from voting or voted Trump and now has the opportunity to make it clear they’ve been upset by the leadership they voted for, awesome

I’d also never encourage anyone to *not* try to make an impact by calling. It just feels weird to see a reaction of “call your reps” today

I don’t think it hurts, and I don’t think I implied that. I do think it perennially shifts the blame to people for not doing enough calling-of-reps in the face of, like, genocide

Makes a pretty direct line between individual actions and continued “failure” to have an impact 

Feels toxic in a way
Calling works for stuff like, yknow, zoning decisions. Not "hey so the president (who has been running several crypto scams) wants to end a civilization
I stg there could be an active extinction level meteor about to crash into the planet and someone will still be posting that it's on us to call our representatives to do something about it
And/or he's just an evil sundowning madman

The rhetoric from the White House keeps escalating because Trump doesn't understand why his advisors want to do war in West Asia so badly (religious psychosis) so he is likely just mad that this is still happening and "what if we just annihilate everyone" seems easier than admitting fault
Feels like maybe the President of the United States publicly threatening to eradicate an entire civilization is—possibly—not the best
